prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. This is a CREATIVE GLAMOUR CHARACTER REDESIGN for ARC Daily's esports stars, not a literal identity-preserving photo edit. The editor has explicitly rejected raw photographic faces pasted onto armor. Make a NEW, IDEALIZED, HEROIC, CLEARLY ILLUSTRATED character loosely inspired by the source. The face MUST be entirely redrawn: polished airbrushed/painted skin, clean sculpted cheekbones, stronger attractive jawline, balanced features, groomed hair, expressive striking eyes, healthy flattering complexion. Remove blemishes, visible pores, under-eye tiredness and incidental snapshot imperfections. Retain only distinctive broad identity cues such as hair color, beard and eyewear so the inspiration is readable. Do NOT retain the exact source photograph's facial geometry, lighting, texture, head pose or awkward snapshot expression. Do NOT paste or reproduce a photographic face. This is the handsome heightened storybook/superhero version of the person, like the established Jack Cole character, not their literal head.
Image1 is the established Jack Cole illustrated character: use its COHERENT PAINTED/INKED HUMAN FACE AND MECHANICALLY INTEGRATED HEADGEAR style only, ignore its face identity, text and history. Image2 is this subject's photograph: use ONLY broad recognizable visual inspiration, deliberately glamour-redesign it as above. Image3 supplies established story/costume/composition context only, not extra characters or another face. Rich premium cinematic CYBERPUNK illustrated realism, stylized graphic-novel facial anatomy and controlled hand-inked planes across face/neck/hands and machines, no photography, no anime, no retro pulp paper or halftone. Face and costume are painted as one original artwork. A bold distinctive narrative role is central, not another generic engineer holding a little cube. Enormous graphics-card equipment, exposed heat sinks, cooling fans, cable conduits and geometric colored square ARC displays remain our world language. All wardrobe and machinery are fantasy editorial character design, not claims about actual competition methods.
Full bleed portrait5:7, ideally1500x2100. Strong composition, head and essential hands/gear fully contained, upper two thirds carry identity and narrative, calmer dark lower edge for later stats. No words, digits, logos, title, caption, watermark, frame, rank or card border. One principal hero. JEROEN: THE TUFA MASTERMIND. Translate the editor's view of Jeroen as Tufa Labs' cerebral grandmaster into a spectacular original COMMANDING STRATEGIST portrait. Broad inspiration only: dark wavy hair, slender metal spectacles, clean-shaven, thoughtful intelligent presence. Recast as a dashing, composed mature mastermind with handsome angular sculpted face, striking dark eyes, elegant slightly swept wavy hair, fine designer spectacles and a confident knowing half-smile. Make the facial glamour transformation UNMISTAKABLE compared to the plain source snapshot. Dramatic art-directed cyan/amber light sculpts his painted face. Do not make him resemble an actor, Jack Cole or another named person.
Narrative composition inspired by Jack's cerebral mentor ROLE in image3: Jeroen seated upright in an imposing floating black-chrome COMMAND THRONE, camera slightly below eye line, one elegant hand raised as though arranging pieces of a vast strategic system. The other rests calmly on a built-in command armrest. His chair's vast spider-like compute architecture forms a purposeful halo: articulated support arms carrying huge GPU cards and spinning cooling turbines, translucent square ARC logic panels arranged as an elegant linked constellation, arcing copper/blue coolant conduits. Two small fluffy black TUFA SPIDER mascots with bright friendly eyes work on a lower chair platform, clearly subordinate comic mascots and not roster headcount. This is a grandmaster orchestrating a whole machine, not a mechanic carrying a loose video card.
Wardrobe is tailored midnight navy/black long coat with subtle gold seams and high sculptural collar, dignified powerful silhouette, refined bronze mechanical gauntlet. Headgear is a beautifully designed slim chrome/cobalt neural crown over the brow with three luminous square processing nodes and a hinged transparent cyan optical insert integrated into ONE spectacle lens, finely machined temple plates, discreet jaw couplers and cables flowing into the command chair. Face is deliberately handsome, idealized, illustrated and expressive. Large remote GPU equipment in the throne provides bulk, leaving the mastermind's head silhouette elegant and readable. Backdrop: monumental Tufa citadel command chamber in the scoring hall, distant suspended ARC grids and architectural webs of cable, depth and imposing scale. A unique cerebral superstar who feels like the center of his team's story.

review: Intermediate glamour redesign. Editor liked the wry face and mastermind pose, then required distinct crimson accents and the actual Tufa Citadel rather than the academy. Superseded by tufa-citadel-v4; preserve as an intermediate original.
commissionAuthority: Boss prioritized Lukas and DZ retro conversions, then six integrated-face-hardware cyberpunk repairs on 30 October 2026.
